snippet.title: Quack Hunters | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4252280/Quack_Hunters/

Quack-quack! Sounds cool, right? Become a crazy duck and hunt monsters in the wild forest with your friends! Kick enemies with your ducky foot, hide from monsters, gather resources, and explore the world. Bet you won't even last ‘til sunrise.

Wishlist on Steam now!
